notes: OpenAI Decisions API (POST https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions; SDK client.decisions.create): gpt-6-luna is the only model; public beta (GA "in the coming weeks"). Question types (OpenAI names): predicate (probability that a condition is true), choice (choice + probabilities + separate confidence), score (probability-weighted average of level indices + probabilities + confidence). Stored as binary / choice / score. A per-question `refusal` answer type exists (policy refusal): it is NOT an abstain output. Text and images (inline base64 data URLs only; up to 128 images per request); non-user roles and files are not supported; `safety_identifier` parameter; ZDR and HIPAA eligible; US and EEA+Switzerland residency. Context window 1,050,000 (max input 922,000 on the Luna page); OpenRouter listing max completion 945,000. Several independent questions in one `questions` array over shared input; dependent decisions need separate requests. Max questions and max choice options are not documented in the pages read (OpenRouter text, secondary, says up to 200 questions).

surfaces.notes: abstain_supported null: only a policy `refusal` answer type is documented. calibration_claimed null: OpenAI publishes no calibration number; Hard-Decisions probed the generative Luna (not this API) and found its stated 99%+ confidence right 68.7% of the time. Nicia measured order sensitivity (8 of 85 decisions changed when records were reversed).
OpenRouter openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions (created 2026-10-06): context 1,050,000; $0.10/M input; completion $0; p50 0.30 s over 3 days.
